entities.name: de Havilland DH.71 Tiger Moth
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The de Havilland DH.71 Tiger Moth was a British single-seat monoplane, designed to research high-speed flight and to test replacement engines for the Cirrus. Only two were built.
